caseName: Howard University v. District of Columbia
caseNameFull: Howard University v. District of Columbia
attorneys: George E. C. Hayes for petitioner. Vernon E. West and George C. Updegraff for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy is of the opinion that the petition should be granted.
